messages:
sam: Hey @lina — pushed a small follow-up to PR #4823. I split the long e2e into a separate smoke job and addressed the serialization comments. PTAL when you have a minute.

lina: Thanks, will take a look in a bit. Quick heads-up: CI had a timeout on the previous run, did you bump any timeouts here or keep the previous values?

sam: I kept the timeouts but refactored the helper. Diff snippet I pushed:
```go
// preserve existing behavior but reduce allocations
if os.Getenv("DISABLE_FALLBACK") == "" {
    enableFallback()
}
```
Also added a fast smoke target: `make smoke-fast` which runs a deterministic subset locally.

tj: ran `make smoke-fast` on macbook, all green here. :white_check_mark: no flakes locally.

lina: LGTM except one nit: logger component name should be `runtime` not `svc`. Can you change and squash?

sam: done — changed logger name and force-pushed the squash (sha: a1b2c3f). Added a CHANGES.md bullet mentioning the smoke job.

lina: :thumbsup: PTAL from me. I won't be online during the 18:00 UTC canary window though. Who wants merge-custody?

sam: @tj can you take merge-custody for the 18:00 UTC canary slot and watch latency/errors? I can be on-call afterwards for roll-forward if needed.

tj: I can do that. I'll monitor the canary and have rollback ready if the tail latency spikes.

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved — 2024-07-05 18:00 UTC. Reminder will post 30m before.

sam: perfect, thanks everyone. tagging for tracking in release notes.

(threads tend to be short — leaving this thread open until rollback window closes)
